data.title: Tandem Mobi Becomes Only Insulin Pump Offering Both Tubed and Tubeless Wear Options
data.description: FDA clears Tandem Diabetes Care's Tandem Mobi as the first tubeless automated insulin delivery system with seven-day wear launching in 2027.

data.title: Nvidia Courting a Former Insider: Arm CEO Rene Haas
data.description: Nvidia reportedly approached Arm CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor to Jensen Huang, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO amid turmoil.

data.title: Why Is IREN Stock Falling on Friday?
data.description: IREN Limited (NASDAQ: IREN) stock falls Friday amid Bitcoin sliding under $70,000, rising Treasury yields, and NVIDIA Corp. (NASDAQ: NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang's resignation.

data.title: Virgin Galactic Faces Cash Burn, Dilution Risks Ahead of 2027 Spaceflight Comeback
data.description: Virgin Galactic expects commercial spaceflight revenue in early 2027, targets positive free cash flow by Q1 2028 and launches a $250 million equity offering.
